name: Jaraicejo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue with a crimson triangle at the hoist.
history: The arms and the flag of Jaraicejo were approved by the Order of 28 May 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 5 June 1993, after the municipal council's approval on 1 June 1992; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three equal horizontal stripes, red above, blue below and white in the centre, charged next to the staff with a crimson triangle with one side along the hoist.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
